type UseMutateFunction<TData = unknown, _TError = DefaultError, TVariables = void, _TOnMutateResult = unknown> = (...args: undefined extends TVariables ? [variables?: TVariables] : [variables: TVariables]) => Promise<TData>;

Defined in: [packages/solid-query/src/types.ts:282](https://github.com/TanStack/query/blob/main/packages/solid-query/src/types.ts#L282)

One `mutate`, returning a safe-to-ignore promise: errors are also routed
into reactive state, and ignoring the promise never surfaces an
unhandled rejection. Call-site callbacks are gone — settle logic that
used to live in `mutate(vars, { onSuccess })` is linear code after
`await mutate(vars)` or a config-level callback.
